big_case.notes: Underlying litigation governs Temporary Protected Status and work authorization for hundreds of thousands of Venezuelan beneficiaries on a fourth trip to the Supreme Court after Mullin v. Doe, 609 U.S. 324 (2026). Event-level significance is materially tempered, however, because 26A714 was a protective stay application triggered by a narrow administrative-stay gap on GVR remand and was voluntarily withdrawn within 24 hours without any Supreme Court order or precedent.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction placed between 2026-11-19T14:33:07Z and 14:53:48Z (result_capture_coverage=0.415 across 53 calls). Live reads of supremecourt.gov/rss/cases/json/26A714.json at 14:36Z and 14:39Z returned only the November 18 submission entry; the Solicitor General's withdrawal letter was filed over six hours later at 15:55:58 ET (20:55:58Z) on 2026-11-19.

central_claims.claim: Justice Kagan will request a prompt response from National TPS Alliance, refer the application to the full Court, 1 or 2 amicus briefs will be filed, and an administrative bridge or final order will issue within roughly a week before the November 20 cliff.
